question: On what basis has the authoritativeness of all scriptures already been established by the author?
premises: Scriptures relate attainable goals and means
The author previously argued for all scriptures' authoritativeness
inference: Thus their authoritativeness is indeed established by the attainable-attainer relation, as stated earlier.
plain_english: Indeed, their authoritativeness consists in being the means to what is to be attained; this has already been stated by us in the discussion on the authoritativeness of all scriptures.
